evidence.alignment: Selected technologies target high-growth segments (EV battery manufacturing, vehicle control integration, solar mobility) with market booms concentrated around 2027-2030, aligning well with the 2030 reference horizon. Solar vehicle integration (T06) carries lower market opportunity scores (2.0), slightly diluting overall alignment.
evidence.sequencing: Dependency chain is correctly respected: T01 (dry electrode film) completes at 2028-Q1 before T02 (high-performance cathode) starts, with zero dependency violations. Minor timing errors exist (T02 completes 1 year after its market boom), but overall sequencing logic is sound.
evidence.investment: High-urgency, high-market-opportunity technologies (T01, T02, T03) are all correctly classified as Strategic tier, while the lower-opportunity, high-uncertainty T06 is appropriately placed at Medium tier. This proportional allocation reflects rational prioritization.
evidence.coherence: T01 and T02 form a coherent battery manufacturing progression, and T03 addresses vehicle control architecture, but the four technologies span two relatively disconnected sub-domains (battery process/materials vs. vehicle architecture/solar) without a unifying strategic narrative linking them into a single platform vision.
evidence.balance: All three core investments are Strategic tier, creating concentration risk at the high end with only one Medium-tier technology. Short-term (T03 by 2027) and longer-term (T06 by 2030) bets are represented, but the portfolio lacks Low-tier exploratory entries and has no explicit hedge against EV market deceleration scenarios.

strengths: Zero dependency violations and correct sequencing of T01→T02 battery development chain demonstrates rigorous feasibility planning.
Investment tier assignments are well-calibrated to market opportunity and urgency scores, with Strategic tier reserved for high-value technologies.
weaknesses: T02 (high-performance cathode) completes approximately 1 year after its market boom (2029-Q1 vs 2028-Q1), risking late-to-market positioning in a competitive cathode materials segment.
Portfolio is heavily concentrated in Strategic tier (3 of 4 technologies), with insufficient exploratory/low-tier diversification to manage technical and market uncertainty.

Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) bidirectional charging (synergistic with vehicle control architecture T03)
